body:
**Description:**
To prevent flash-loan-style manipulation of Attestor Reputation, we need a Time-Weighted Average Reputation (TWAR) system. Iterating over history on-chain is too gas-intensive. We must implement a highly optimized, updatable Segment Tree (or Fenwick Tree / Binary Indexed Tree) natively in the Soroban smart contract to allow $O(\log n)$ updates and $O(\log n)$ historical range queries for reputation metrics.

**Requirements & Complexity:**
- **Gas-Optimized Storage:** Design the tree structure to minimize Soroban ledger entry reads/writes, perhaps by packing multiple tree nodes into a single byte array.
- **Decay Function:** Incorporate a mathematical time-decay function into the tree nodes so older reputation scores naturally lose weight over time.
- **Challenge:** Implementing complex tree-based data structures within the strict execution and storage limits of the Soroban environment without causing out-of-gas errors during tree rebalancing.
